correctness.rationale: For all d>=2 and orthogonal R, cube width support reduces to paired orthonormal absolute coordinates. A standard bivariate normal absolute-product identity and Gaussian radial factorization give the exact 2/(d*pi) sum g(Rij^2). The exact integral g''(s)>=1/12 and sum Rij^2=d give the quadratic defect and Hadamard equality, with no unattained equality asserted. Haar averaging in R forces strictly negative reference bound. Gamma/Taylor expansion gives -1/(6*pi*d). Packaged checker covers support identities, direct mixed-moment comparisons, arbitrary orthogonal frames, explicit dimensions and asymptotics. Numerical evidence is supportive only.
